content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] AC/DC 24V [article_no]. [url] I want to copy the program from this device to another identical one. I've learned that a memory card can be used for this purpose, but which card will work with my model? I've seen several with different colors, such as... [url] Any advice would be appreciated.
There is an FAQ from [company_name]: Which [product_name] memory/battery cards are compatible with various [product_name] device series?

Thank you for your reply. I plan to purchase a new card. If I understand correctly, I need to select either the purple or dark brown card? When using the card, do I just insert it into the first device, copy the program, and then transfer it to the second, or is there anything else required? Thanks again.
Hello, Yes, and please refer to page 231: [url]

That's correct. If you do not require a battery, the purple option is suitable. If you need a card with battery, choose the dark brown one. Please consult the manual, chapter 6, for detailed instructions on the copy operation. [document]
Thank you all for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about which memory card is compatible with their specific [product_name] hardware, and color differences among memory cards create uncertainty. They also seek clarification on the exact steps for transferring programs between identical devices. As official documentation is not immediately understandable for everyone, community advice and references, including manuals and FAQs, play an important role in resolving these issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to easily identify and purchase a compatible memory card for transferring programs, and clearly understand the proper steps for using it with their [product_name] [article_no] device.
